name: Kentucky Rook
description: Rook variant for four in fixed partnerships. 45 cards (2s-4s removed). Bid from 100 in multiples of 5, take nest, discard five (no point cards), name trump. Trick play; Rook highest trump; 180 points per deal. First team to 500 wins.

history.origins: Kentucky Rook derives from Rook (published 1906 by Parker Brothers). Popular in Eastern Kentucky; rules from contributor John Hay.
timeline: 1906: Parker Brothers introduced the Rook deck; Kentucky Rook derives from that tradition and became popular in Eastern Kentucky.

setup.deck: Rook deck with 2s, 3s, 4s removed (45 cards including Rook)
setup.dealing: Ten cards each, one at a time; five cards to the nest. Dealer adds one card to the nest after each of the first five rounds.

rules.objective: As the bidding team, take at least the number of card points you bid; as the opposing team, score the points you take. First team to reach 500 or more points wins.
rules.gameplay: Four in fixed partnerships. Deal 10 each, 5 to nest. Bid from 100 in multiples of 5 (left of dealer first); three passes leave the fourth as high bidder; if first three pass, dealer must bid 100. Bidder picks up nest (15 cards), discards five face-down (no point cards), names trump. Left of bidder leads; follow color; Rook is highest trump. Highest trump wins trick, else highest of led color. Bidder's team makes bid scores their points, else subtracts bid; other team always scores its points. Game to 500.
keyRules: 10 each, 5 to nest. Min bid 100, multiples of 5. Bidder takes nest, discards 5 (no point cards), names trump. Follow color; Rook highest trump. 180 points per deal. First to 500 wins.

strategy.basic: Bid when you have good trump and point cards; avoid overbidding.
strategy.intermediate: Count trumps and key cards; adjust bidding and play.
strategy.advanced: Partnership signaling and endplay; near-optimal bidding and defense.
tips: Bidder may not put point cards in the nest.
If first three pass, dealer must bid 100.

variations.name: Rook as lowest trump
variations.description: Some play with the Rook as the lowest card of the trump color rather than the highest.

variations.emptyOverridesReason: Different deck and bidding constants; overrides to be added when implementing this variant.

scoring.description: Card points: 1=15, 14=10, 10=10, 5=5, Rook=20 (180 per deal). Bidder's team scores its points if they make the bid, else subtracts the bid; other team always scores its points. First team to 500 wins.
scoring.winCondition: First team to 500 or more; higher score wins.

synthesis.shortDescription: Rook for four in fixed partnerships; 45 cards, bid for nest and trump, first to 500 wins.
